title: One-step acceptance probability recurrence
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine on a Boolean input $x$, and let $C$ be a configuration on that input. For every $j\in\mathbb{N}$, the probability that a uniformly random choice word of length $j+1$ leads from $C$ to a halted configuration with output exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$ is the average of the corresponding length-$j$ probabilities starting from the configurations reached from $C$ by one step with choice bit $\mathrm{true}$ and with choice bit $\mathrm{false}$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a configuration of N on x
